blocks.raw: Adaptive Media Delivery (AMD) is optimized for adaptive bit rate streaming to provide a high-quality, secure viewing experience across a broad variety of network types—fixed or mobile—at varying connection speeds. Built on the ​Akamai​ Intelligent Platform™, AMD provides superior scalability, reliability, availability, and reach.

blocks.raw: Follow these phases to get set up with a new AMD property.
blocks.text: Follow these phases to get set up with a new AMD property.

blocks.raw:
1. [Create a new AMD property](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs/create-new-prop). Quickly create a new AMD property in Property Manager.

2. [Define Property Hostnames](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs/define-prop-hn). Associate the domain for your streaming media with an ​Akamai​ domain, so requests for it resolve to the ​Akamai​ edge network where your media is cached.

3. [Define Property Configuration Settings](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs/define-prop-config-settings). Set up best practice delivery features to streamline and protect your content.

4. [Finalize your AMD property](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs/finalize-amd-prop). Do a few final things in and out of your Adaptive Media Delivery property to get ready to test it.
